assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 平急两用空间涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与建设控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and control conditions are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 能耗与应急资源统计仅作概念性公共数据服务方向建议，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息与实测数据。
assumptions.statement_en: Energy and emergency-resource accounting is a concept-level public data service suggestion, not official statistics or measured data.

assumptions.statement_zh: 两用厅、转承廊与安备庭三节点均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 设施状态感知与公众参与仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Facility-state sensing and public participation process anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: 平急转换演练日、两用空间体验季与韧性社区工作坊周均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The drill day, dual-use experience season and resilient-community workshop are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.
